nf2efd4dafc.headline: America's Uber to seal $3.1 billion deal to buy Dubai-based Careem this week
nf2efd4dafc.summary: Uber plans to buy Careem in a deal valued at $3.1 billion, with payments in cash and convertible notes, expanding its Middle East presence.
nf2efd4dafc.why: This acquisition enhances Uber's ride-hailing market share in the Middle East and impacts regional transportation competition.
